name: Dean Francois
office: City of Hermosa Beach, Member of the City Council

items.text: Dean Francois is a member of the Hermosa Beach City Council who served as mayor in 2025. He says he held monthly town halls as mayor. A former federal budget manager and investigator, he has led the local Sierra Club and served on the Los Angeles County Library Commission and the Santa Monica Bay Restoration Commission.

sentences.text: Dean Francois is a member of the Hermosa Beach City Council who served as mayor in 2025.
He says he held monthly town halls as mayor.
A former federal budget manager and investigator, he has led the local Sierra Club and served on the Los Angeles County Library Commission and the Santa Monica Bay Restoration Commission.

items.text: He opposed the half-cent sales tax ballot measure, arguing residents would bear the cost. He wants to streamline business permits. He voted against ending free holiday parking. His campaign says he pioneered higher e-bike fines. He supports requiring e-bike licenses. He says he brokered a compromise on short-term rentals to gather data before regulating. He voted to adopt the short-term rental ordinance.
